visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable views, including the retained 1024×640 summary. The irregular low ring and open courtyard, yellow portal and wings, white pointed blind-arch trim, deep pointed recess and clear rectangular passage, paired tapered minarets with blue bands and open capped lanterns, and west veranda with green columns and white beams/brackets are present. Removed the low roof strip that crossed the passage and removed a duplicate yellow ceiling reveal over the veranda plaster. Fine historic decoration and inscriptions are abstracted; garden, trees, street furniture, carpets, furnished interiors and adjacent buildings are excluded.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views, including the placement overlay. Seven existing 256² graphs provide yellow glazed brick, pale raw/coursed limestone, lime plaster, green timber, blue ceramic and cast bronze. Seven merged roles use metric UVs and linear tints, with no embedded images or unique atlas. Graphs are read once and model geometry is disposed on eviction. Precise building subtraction preserves all 60 nearby buildings, including a southern building sharing boundary vertices with zero area overlap; the coarse occupancy raster would incorrectly claim that neighbor, so its fallback is disabled by the explicit cutout. Two exact notched terrain masks retain the courtyard ground. Corrected final views show land in the courtyard, and unload restores the terrain opening state.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. The low irregular compound, open courtyard, yellow gate, twin tower silhouettes and sheltered green colonnade remain visible. Skyline retains 11 coarse columns, a clear gate and four-post open lanterns; district restores 21 columns, blind niches and three blue bands; street restores 42 columns, joists, finer lanterns and original coarse band diamonds; closeup adds brackets and backing panels. Street overview cameras favor the courtyard and crop the gateway; dedicated details cover the gate and veranda. Context houses are synthetic. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city timings remain unmeasured.
